title: Generate code and curl paste
brief: Generate code for the request (curl, HTTPie, Python requests, JavaScript fetch), opened from the request line, the command palette and the tree menu, read-only with Copy and secrets kept as {{variables}}; pasting a curl command into the URL bar replaces the request and reports what was imported, the ignored options and Undo.

artboards.title: Dialog and toast
artboards.tradeoff: Focused and familiar (palette-style dialog); hides the request while open, and the paste report vanishes with the toast

artboards.title: Code tab and banner
artboards.tradeoff: Code stays live beside the draft and the paste report stays in place until dismissed; takes the response pane and adds a fourth response tab
